payload.name: Mythsensus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mythsensus runs one birth date through 26 astrology and divination traditions — BaZi, Vedic, Western, Nine Star Ki, Thai astrology and more — and puts the answers side by side. Instead of one voice, you see where the traditions agree and where they openly disagree, with each tradition's own rule shown.

In ChatGPT you can get a Cosmic Score from five core systems, a daily reading, the lore of 1,069 deities across 20+ mythologies, and the actual rules each system uses to calculate.

Mythsensus is for reflection and cultural curiosity, not advice. It gives no lottery numbers and makes no guarantees about outcomes.

payload.name: Julius: Sports Stats & Fantasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Julius is a sports stats and fantasy sports assistant for comparing players, teams and seasons. Explore sports data from uploaded files, saved Julius files or accessible public sources, then create custom rankings, charts and matchup reports.

Player and team comparisons: Analyze game logs, box scores, season totals, per-game averages, head-to-head results and home-away splits. Compare NBA basketball, NFL football, soccer, MLB baseball and NHL hockey statistics when the relevant data is available.

Fantasy football and fantasy basketball: Calculate fantasy points using your league's PPR, half-PPR, standard or custom scoring settings. Compare players, prepare draft cheat sheets and evaluate fantasy roster scenarios. Use supplied or retrievable, dated rankings and projections for trade analysis, start/sit questions, waiver wire research and average draft position (ADP) comparisons.

Sports analytics: Explore shooting efficiency, passing, rushing and receiving production, targets, goals and assists, batting and pitching trends, and other sport-specific metrics. Analyze expected goals (xG), shot locations and advanced statistics when the source includes the required fields.

Create sports charts, player comparison tables, scouting notes and reports. Save your work privately in Julius, continue it later, and publish a saved file when you ask for a public link.

Coverage and freshness depend on your inputs and accessible sources. Results identify the season, date range and assumptions used. Connect your Julius account to get started.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Compare player and team statistics, Analyze game logs, Calculate fantasy points, Evaluate fantasy roster scenarios, Create sports charts and reports, Save sports files, Publish sports reports

payload.name: PartyCam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PartyCam turns your guests' phones into one shared camera. Tell ChatGPT about your party, birthday, wedding or shower, and PartyCam creates a photo album for it: you get a QR code and a link to share with up to 10 guests. Guests scan the code and take photos right in their phone's browser, with no app to install, and every photo lands in one album. PartyCam emails you a link to save the album to your phone, see the photos as they arrive and download them after the event.

payload.name: Maybelline NY Makeup Try On
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Experience Maybelline New York Makeup Virtual Try-On directly inside ChatGPT. Explore shades and finishes, try on selected products in real time, and find where to buy online or nearby.

This plugin uses Google Analytics 4 (with advertising features and personalization disabled) to collect usage and performance diagnostics to improve service reliability.  Please see our Privacy Notice and click here to learn how Google processes data https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

Product carousel details (such as product name, images, description, and ingredients) are provided directly via Maybelline’s server.  Any surrounding text, conversational commentary, comparisons, or performance claims are generated independently by ChatGPT’s AI model. Maybelline does not endorse, verify, or assume responsibility for claims, statements, or representations generated through ChatGPT inference that extend beyond our official product listings.

payload.name: Kidoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kidoo creates personalized, illustrated children's books where the child is the hero. Ask about themes, art styles, prices in your currency and how the book is delivered, get ideas for birthday gifts and party favors, and start a book here that you finish on the Kidoo site. Photos of the child are only ever uploaded on the Kidoo site, never in the chat. Payment also happens on the Kidoo site.

payload.name: Dun Dun Dungeon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dun Dun Dungeon is a narrative dungeon-crawling game. Create a persistent character, describe what they try in freeform chat, and play through server-resolved rooms. Earn fictional in-game rewards and build dungeons for other players to explore.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create and play narrative dungeons, Build player-authored dungeons, Track persistent characters and loot

payload.name: Partynado
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover public parties in Switzerland and Germany. Browse event cards, see local dates, venues and admission prices, and open details on Partynado. Refine location, date, music or budget in chat. Unknown prices are shown explicitly. No account or purchase is required.

payload.name: SeatCommons
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search upcoming concerts, sports, theater and comedy on SeatCommons. Read event dates and venues, compare seats by quantity, section and budget, and get a link to complete checkout on SeatCommons. No SeatCommons account is needed to browse. All four tools are read-only: no holds, orders or payments. Prices include processing and exclude sales tax. Prices match the standard SeatCommons website price. A lower first-order price, when available, is shown separately and applies only to a buyer's first SeatCommons order. Checkout verifies eligibility and the final fee. Buying requires sign-in, phone verification, review of terms and authorized payment. Checkout is US-only. Availability can change; some links open an event date and require seat selection again.

payload.name: Statz Football
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Look up football (soccer) statistics and Statz model projections in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- See the top 10 teams and players the Statz model projects for matches in the next 7 days: win probability, both teams to score, clean sheets, team goals, shots, corners, cards, player goals, assists and more.
- Check season stat leaders in a competition: top scorers, assists, shots, tackles, and team goals, shots and corners.
- Find players on active streaks, such as a shot on target in every recent game.
- Compare both teams' season leaders for an upcoming match.
- List upcoming fixtures with the model's win, draw and loss probabilities.

Answers come with a ranked board and links to the full stats on statz.ai. Open Statz from the sidebar to browse the boards by competition, or mention a team, player or competition in the ChatGPT desktop app.

Statz covers the Premier League, Europe's top leagues, lower English divisions and international football. It provides statistics and projections only: no odds and no betting services.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Top-10 model projections for the next 7 days, Season stat leaders for players and teams, Active player streaks, Both teams' leaders for a match, Upcoming fixtures with win, draw and loss probabilities

payload.name: Airline Executive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read-only companion for Airline Executive, an airline-management game. Ask about game mechanics such as offline catch-up, simulation time, airports, aircraft, research and route feasibility without signing in. Connect your own Airline Executive account to analyse your authorised airlines, fleet, routes, flights, finances, maintenance, research, contracts and loans. The plugin cannot purchase, sell, lease, schedule, maintain, borrow, research or otherwise change gameplay state.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read public Airline Executive game knowledge, Explain offline operation and catch-up reconciliation, Search airport and aircraft game data, Read authorised airline data, Analyse airline performance, Interactive multi-airline and finite-choice selection
